office: Majority Leader, Massachusetts House of Representatives
label: Written by AI from public sources — may contain errors.

items.t: Said the biggest hurdle to a temporary Senate appointment is that nobody, including him, wants it to be seen as a handoff.
items.q: The biggest hurdle is that nobody, including me, wants to see this is as a handoff,” that is, having the governor appoint someone temporarily who then becomes the front-runner in the special election for the permanent seat, Moran said.

record.t: Served as co-chairman of the Joint Committee on Election Laws.
record.q: state Rep. Michael Moran, a Boston Democrat and co-chairman of the Joint Committee on Election Laws.

record.t: Co-filed a bill with Sen. Linda Dorcena Forry that taxi drivers voiced approval of at a hearing.
record.q: dozens of cabbies — in yellow shirts — registered their approval for the bill filed by Sen. Linda Dorcena Forry and Rep. Michael Moran.

record.t: Sponsored House Bill H.237 on the issuance and sale of sports and entertainment tickets.
record.q: By Mr. Moran of Boston, a petition (accompanied by bill, House, No. 237) of Michael J. Moran relative to the issuance and sale of sports and entertainment tickets.
